guideTitle: The Best USB-C and Thunderbolt Docks for Surface Pro and Surface Laptop
metaTitle: Best Docking Stations for Surface Pro and Surface Laptop (2026)
metaDescription: We compared USB-C hubs and Thunderbolt 4 docks for recent Surface Pro and Surface Laptop models on displays, charging, ports and portability.
introParagraphs: Recent Surface Pro and Surface Laptop models have USB-C, and some models also support Thunderbolt 4, so they work with standard USB-C hubs and Thunderbolt docks as well as Microsoft's own Surface Connect docks (not covered here). Check which ports your specific model has before choosing between a hub and a Thunderbolt dock.

Surface devices are often undocked and carried, so size matters as much as port count. Small hubs pass through your charger's power; larger docks and Thunderbolt docks supply their own and suit a permanent desk. How many external monitors you can run depends on the Surface model.
Our comparison is based on published specifications and price position, not hands-on testing. Prices range from about $27 to $270 at the time of writing.

anker-prime-docking-station-14-port.summary: A 14-port USB-C dock with up to 160W output, dual 4K and 10Gbps data.
anker-prime-docking-station-14-port.description:
The Anker Prime is the full desk dock for a USB-C Surface: 14 ports, up to 160W total output, dual 4K display support and 10Gbps data, listed for USB-C Windows laptops.

It stays on the desk and charges the Surface through one cable. It costs about $170 at the time of writing.
anker-prime-docking-station-14-port.bestFor: A permanent Surface desk with many peripherals.
anker-prime-docking-station-14-port.skipIf: You carry your dock; the Anker Nano is smaller.

plugable-16-in-1-thunderbolt-4-dock.summary: A certified 16-in-1 Thunderbolt 4 dock with dual 4K, 100W charging and driverless setup.
plugable-16-in-1-thunderbolt-4-dock.description:
The Plugable 16-in-1 is the most complete dock for a Surface with Thunderbolt 4: certified, driverless, 16 ports, dual 4K display support and 100W charging.

It is the most expensive dock here at about $270 at the time of writing. On a Surface without Thunderbolt, a USB-C dock is the better value.
pros: Most ports on a TB4 dock
plugable-16-in-1-thunderbolt-4-dock.bestFor: Thunderbolt-equipped Surface models at a full desk.

ugreen-7-in-1-revodok-pro.summary: A 7-in-1 hub with dual 4K 60Hz HDMI, 10Gbps data and 100W pass-through.
ugreen-7-in-1-revodok-pro.description:
The UGREEN Revodok Pro 7-in-1 is the low-cost choice: two HDMI outputs listed for 4K 60Hz, 10Gbps data and 100W pass-through in a compact body, for about $27 at the time of writing.

It has no Ethernet or card reader.
ugreen-7-in-1-revodok-pro.bestFor: Surface owners who need a monitor and a few ports.
ugreen-7-in-1-revodok-pro.skipIf: You need Ethernet; the Anker 8-in-1 has it.

plugable-thunderbolt-4-dock-tbt-udm.summary: A certified Thunderbolt 4 dock with dual 4K or single 6K and 100W charging.
plugable-thunderbolt-4-dock-tbt-udm.description:
The Plugable TBT-UDM is the smaller, cheaper Thunderbolt 4 option: certified and driverless, with dual 4K HDMI or single 6K display support and 100W charging, in a compact desktop footprint.

It costs about $70 less than the Plugable 16-in-1 at the time of writing.
plugable-thunderbolt-4-dock-tbt-udm.bestFor: Thunderbolt Surface models on a smaller desk.
plugable-thunderbolt-4-dock-tbt-udm.skipIf: You need the most ports; the 16-in-1 has more.

anker-laptop-docking-station-8-in-1.summary: An 8-in-1 hub with two HDMI ports, Ethernet and 85W pass-through.
anker-laptop-docking-station-8-in-1.description:
The Anker 8-in-1 adds gigabit Ethernet to two HDMI outputs and 85W pass-through in a compact size, for about $54 at the time of writing.

Its small size suits Surface owners who undock often.
anker-laptop-docking-station-8-in-1.bestFor: Surface users who want wired networking in a small hub.

acer-usb-c-docking-station-9-in-1.summary: An Acer 9-in-1 hub with two HDMI ports for about $35.
acer-usb-c-docking-station-9-in-1.description: The Acer 9-in-1 offers two HDMI outputs in a compact dock for about $35 at the time of writing, but the listing gives few other details.

anker-nano-laptop-docking-station-8-in-1.summary: A nano 8-in-1 hub with 4K HDMI, SD/TF and 85W pass-through.
anker-nano-laptop-docking-station-8-in-1.description: The Anker Nano 8-in-1 is the most portable option here, with 4K 60Hz HDMI, 10Gbps USB-C, two USB-A ports, an SD/TF reader and 85W pass-through, for about $30 at the time of writing.
anker-nano-laptop-docking-station-8-in-1.bestFor: Surface owners who carry a hub.

anker-nano-13-in-1-laptop-docking-statio.summary: A 13-in-1 dock with 2 HDMI + DisplayPort and a detachable travel hub.
anker-nano-13-in-1-laptop-docking-statio.description:
The Anker Nano 13-in-1 supports up to three displays, with 10Gbps USB-C, up to 100W power delivery and a detachable 6-in-1 module that can travel with the Surface.

Three displays depend on your Surface model's support.
anker-nano-13-in-1-laptop-docking-statio.bestFor: Multi-monitor Surface desks without a Thunderbolt dock.
anker-nano-13-in-1-laptop-docking-statio.skipIf: You use one or two monitors.

buyingCriteria.explanation: Check whether your model has Thunderbolt 4 or USB-C only.
If you undock often, a small hub (Anker Nano, UGREEN) is easier to carry.
Hubs pass through your charger; powered and Thunderbolt docks supply up to 100–160W.
External monitor support varies by Surface model.

faq.q: Do I need a Surface Dock?
faq.a: No. Recent Surface models with USB-C work with standard USB-C hubs and, if they support it, Thunderbolt docks. Microsoft's Surface Connect docks are an alternative not covered here.
It depends on the model. Check Microsoft's specifications for yours.

faq.q: How many monitors can my Surface run?
faq.a: It depends on the model; check Microsoft's documentation before buying a multi-display dock.

bottomLine: For a Surface you carry, the Anker Nano 8-in-1 and UGREEN 7-in-1 are the compact, inexpensive choices, and the Anker 8-in-1 adds Ethernet.
At a permanent desk, the Plugable Thunderbolt docks suit Thunderbolt-equipped models, the Anker Prime is the powered USB-C option, and the Anker Nano 13-in-1 handles three displays.
